DCF fair value is estimated at $1.95 vs the current price of $1.65, representing a margin of safety of 18.2%. Quantitative technicals indicate an intact primary uptrend with price above the 200-day moving average ($1.5). Systematic 3-tier accumulation is recommended at $1.62 (Tranche 1), $1.52 (Tranche 2), and $1.4 (Tranche 3).
